No planned test fails first for the nav insert on every page, so the task 4.8 code would have no failing-first proof. The Phase 1 tests pin only index.html (preview-gate.test.ts:1086-1098). (b) The note does not say that the `Review` link in the preview index.html is a dead link until task 4.8 writes review.html. Plan line 95 still says `each page` with no Phase 1 limit. Add one sentence to plan line 95 that names the dead Review link in Phases 1 to 3.

C5-2 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:26 and :106-108, :180-182: The header says `Each refusal prints one line on stdout`. The drift step prints one line for each drifted entry, so two or more lines are possible. An unreadable docs/ root pushes the prefix `""`, so the line is `publish: drift ` with an empty path. Fix: state that drift prints one line for each entry, and map the root case to a named path such as `docs`.

C5-3 [Nit] review-c: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:124 and header lines 24-28: The walk starts at `join(ROOT, "docs")` with readdirSync. It does not lstat the docs/ root. If docs/ is itself a symlink, the walk follows it, the base check passes through the link, and the copy loop (:185-189) writes through the link. The header says the walk never follows a link. preview.sh refuses this case (`find` at :105 matches the root link), but publish.ts does not. The case is not reachable in the tracked tree. By code trace; I could not build the approval record in a temp copy because the guard blocks writes under a measure/ path. Fix: lstat the docs/ root and refuse with `publish: drift docs`, or state the limit in the header.
